safety_verdicts.content: Diarrhoea is associated with abdominal pain.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold includes abdominal pain associated with diarrhea; generated facts do not mention abdominal pain.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting associated abdominal pain reduces clinical context for acute diarrhea and could delay consideration of alternate or more serious intra-abdominal causes (e.g., inflammatory/infectious colitis, surgical abdomen) and appropriate safety-netting. In this otherwise stable presentation, the most likely impact is reduced diagnostic accuracy and follow-up planning rather than immediate harm.
